deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash
ai_typeOfModel: Multimodal Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) with a Causal Encoder-Decoder (CED) architecture: a 40-layer Transformer (20-layer causal encoder followed by a 20-layer decoder)
@graph.ai_informationAboutApplication: Target systems: Agentic workloads/agent systems (code agents, visual agents, agent scaffolds such as Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode, mini-SWE, DeepSeek Harness), with tool calling and chat/API-based prompt encoding

@graph.ai_informationAboutTraining: Pre-trained from scratch on a multimodal corpus of 45T tokens (sparse attention at 64K sequence length, context extended to 1M at 34T tokens); post-training follows SFT → RL → on-policy distillation (OPD), with changes in the data pipeline (large-scale automated synthesis of agent tasks and environments).
@graph.comment:
releaseTime: release date not stated in the card; Hugging Face repo creation time used.
access_conditions: false
additional_assets: Released alongside the model: a technical report PDF; an `encoding` folder with a Python reference implementation (encoding.py) and test cases for prompt encoding; the deepseek-recipe Rust libraries with Python bindings (GitHub); an `inference` folder with instructions for weight conversion and running inference locally; an `evaluation` folder with instructions for reproducing DeepSWE v1.1 results (dsh-minimal and mini-swe-agent), including a patch for integrating dsh-minimal with Pier.
architecture_details: Multimodal MoE with 552B backbone parameters, up to one million tokens context. Causal Encoder-Decoder: 40-layer Transformer (20-layer causal encoder, 20-layer decoder); decoder's global KV cache projected from final encoder hidden states, so only 8B parameters active per token in prefill and 16B in decode, improving cost efficiency for input-heavy agentic workloads. 1 shared expert and 384 routed experts per MoE layer, 6 routed experts active per token. Uses CSA2 (Full, Reindex, Reuse modes) with FP4 main KV caching, reducing global KV cache to 890 bytes per token (roughly 1/4 of DeepSeek-V4-Flash).
design_rationale: Post-training follows the standard SFT → RL → on-policy distillation (OPD) paradigm without algorithmic modifications, with all substantive changes in the data pipeline (large-scale automated synthesis of agent tasks and environments, progressive scaling of data, tasks, and rollouts). Architecturally, the Causal Encoder-Decoder projects the decoder's global KV cache from final encoder hidden states, activating only 8B parameters per token during prefill and 16B during decode to improve cost efficiency for input-heavy agentic workloads.
integration_means: No Jinja chat template; a Python reference prompt-encoding implementation (encoding.py in the encoding folder) is provided, plus deepseek-recipe (Rust libraries with Python bindings) for production prompt encoding/parsing of Messages, Chat Completions and Responses API requests. Local inference instructions (weight conversion and running) are in the inference folder. Recommended sampling: temperature 1.0, top_p 0.95 or 1.0.
eval_methodology: Base models evaluated in an internal framework under the same settings, with few-shot counts per benchmark (e.g. 5-shot MMLU-Pro, 0-shot HumanEval). Instruct results use max reasoning effort (reasoning_effort=100) with temperature=1.0, top_p=0.95. Code agent benchmarks use the Minimal mode of DeepSeek Harness with a 1M-token context window; mini-SWE harness for DeepSWE v1.1; Claude Code harness for SEC-Bench Pro; visual agent benchmarks use Claude Code harness with 512k-token context.
